summary.text: Kt Jacobs is the Republican candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 39B in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Amáda Márquez Simula in a race with no incumbent.
She owns a business providing substance use assessments and has a background in middle and corporate management, according to her Ballotpedia survey from 2024.

paragraphs.text: Kt Jacobs was born in Wisconsin, graduated from Wauconda High School, and earned an associate degree from Colorado Mountain College in 1984, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has been a homeowner in the district for 31 years, volunteered for 12 years as a union master executive chair, and operates a business providing DOT and general substance use assessments and non-clinical training.
Ballotpedia lists her as a former volunteer with Southern Anoka County Assistance and as a member of the Lions Club and Kiwanis.
Jacobs was the Republican candidate in District 39B in 2024, when incumbent Sandra Feist defeated her in the general election, 70.9 percent to 28.9 percent.
She won the August 11, 2026 Republican primary.
In the 2024 survey, she wrote that her campaign focused on taxes and the economy, and on education funding and state mandates on schools.
